name: Development Economics
summary: Research studies well-being, inequality, and economic development, including gaps in education, health, employment, and public safety.
overview: The area examines how institutions and socioeconomic conditions affect households and communities, with empirical work focused on Mexico and other lower- and middle-income settings.

projects.title: Inequality and Intergenerational Persistence in Mexico: A Subnational Great Gatsby Curve Using EMOVI 2023
projects.summary: Measures how inequality and social mobility vary across regions and groups in Mexico using EMOVI 2023.

projects.title: Inequality, Economic Conditions, and Crime Types: Evidence from Mexican Municipalities
projects.summary: Studies how municipal economic and social conditions relate to different types of crime across Mexico.

projects.title: Child Labor, Workplace Risks, and Health Outcomes in Mexico
projects.summary: Uses Mexico’s ENTI 2022 survey to study children’s work risks and associated health outcomes.
